title: 6.1.3 Sub-build: An aim line
description: A ball, a pointer and a line. The smallest possible aim, before there is a table.
unit: 6.1 Pocket: plan and the aim line

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: There is a cue ball in the middle. Move the pointer and nothing happens: there is no line yet.

steps.title: Draw while held
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, inside `if (mouse.pressing())`, draw `line(cue.x, cue.y, mouse.x, mouse.y)`. Set the stroke colour before the line, and clear it after.
hints: `line()` is 6.1.2: four numbers, x1 y1 x2 y2.
Without the press test the line follows the pointer all the time.

steps.title: Show the pull
steps.instructions: Also inside the press test, show the distance from the ball to the pointer with `text(round(dist(cue.x, cue.y, mouse.x, mouse.y)), 12, 24)`.
hints: `dist(x1, y1, x2, y2)` returns a number.
Round it: a long decimal is hard to read.

requirements.title: The line follows the pointer
requirements.description: A line joins the ball and the pointer while the button is held. Help: 6.1.2 (Reading: The pointer: press, hold, let go)

requirements.title: The pull is shown
requirements.description: The distance from the ball to the pointer is shown as a number. Help: 6.1.2 (Reading: The pointer: press, hold, let go)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: An aim line". The task: draw a line from the cue ball to the pointer inside a mouse.pressing() test, and show the pull distance as a rounded number. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Only while held
rubric.description: The line is inside a press/hold test, so it is not drawn all the time.

rubric.title: From the ball to the pointer
rubric.description: The line uses the ball's x/y and mouse.x/mouse.y, in either order.

rubric.title: The pull is visible
rubric.description: A distance is shown, rounded or not.
